description: Find live jobs when the user has a keyword, place, company, remote, and/or seniority, not a theyond job URL (use get_job for that). Need q, location, company, remote=true, seniority, or new=true. new=true searches just-added jobs on homepage Hiring now (same set as hiring_now), still max 10. Not posted_at. Returns at most 10 theyond.com pages, no pagination, no employer apply URLs. Cite title_hub_url, location_hub_url, or location_title_hub_url when the card includes them. Do not invent a hub slug. theyond_verified_at is when theyond last saw the listing on the employer board, not the posted date. salary is the employer feed wage, or the amount harvested from the JD when the feed had none. People apply from the theyond page.

company.description: Employer name, case-insensitive. nvidia matches NVIDIA. Optional if q, location, remote, seniority, or new is set.

location.description: City, region, or country. Optional if q, company, remote, seniority, or new is set.

new.description: If true, only just-added jobs on homepage Hiring now (same set as hiring_now). Still max 10. Can be the only filter. Not posted_at.

q.description: Keywords for title, company, or description. Optional if location, company, remote, seniority, or new is set. Do not pass a theyond.com/jobs URL here.

remote.description: If true, only remote jobs. The title or location says remote, or the description was read as remote. Combine with q or company.

seniority.description: If set, only jobs at that level: intern, entry, mid, senior, staff_lead, or director.

name: search_jobs
